scenes.text: A *29-year-old* cleaner used AI to go from *$242K* to *$1.3 million*

scenes.title: Who: *Rick Chorney*, 29
lines: Abbotsford, British Columbia. Started subcontracting cleaning jobs at about $14 an hour.
Co-founded Echo Janitorial Services in 2023 with his friend Adrian.
Construction sites and offices. Sixteen cleaners today.

scenes.title: The *AI* part
lines: ChatGPT first, just to polish emails. Then Claude as a business advisor: labor law, case studies, operations manuals.
Perplexity for research, Grok for content.
"I went a little crazy," he said.

scenes.title: The *receptionist*
lines: Jobber's AI receptionist answers up to 15 calls an hour for $99 a month.
A human doing that job: about $4,000 a month, per Fortune.
Fixer AI sorts his inbox. Email takes 20 minutes a day.

scenes.title: The *numbers*
lines: $242,000 two years ago. Just under $1 million last year.
On track to clear $1.3 million this year.
Workdays went from about 19 hours to eight.

scenes.title: The *lesson*
lines: He didn't build an AI company. He put AI under a cleaning company.
"I don't have to be doing all the things I'm doing."

scenes.text: Want the *$99 AI receptionist* setup? Comment *PHONE* and follow.
